changelog:
* **feat: preset-only breakdown card in quantity sheet** (3b0ab25)
  - Show the selected preset count's amount and its words on the card.
  - Prefix the words line with "In words:" and keep it centered.
  - Show a hint asking to select a quantity when nothing is pending.
  - Hide the amount again once the stepper or the custom field is used.
  - Drop the grand total preview from the sheet.
  - Remove the now-unused grand total parameter from the sheet.
* **style: match denomination chip to quantity box** (0e3318b)
  - Use the same 16dp corner radius on the denomination chip as the quantity box.
  - Add the same 1dp outline border the quantity box shows in its empty state.
  - Keep the teal secondary container fill and its label color.
* **fix: drop duplicate pieces counter** (87c6646)
  - Remove the total pieces text from the right side of the Cash Breakdown header.
  - The pieces stat still lives on the dashboard card so it is no longer shown twice.
  - Leave the section header with its title only.
* **fix: center row count in the quantity box** (a179602)
  - Move the weight modifier from the count text to the animated content that holds it so the row layout honors it.
  - Keep the count full-width and center-aligned inside that space.
  - The empty 0 placeholder and any selected count now share the same centered position.
* **fix: stop sheet scrollbar stretching** (8d2c9b0)
  - Replace matchParentSize with an end alignment so the scrollbar canvas stays 4dp wide and never fills the whole sheet.
  - Re-measure the indicator against the shrunken viewport when the soft keyboard appears.
  - Guard the draw logic against stretched canvases so no giant rounded track can render.
  - Document that callers must pass positioning-only modifiers.
